decision: Implement fresh owned paired workers for each geometric N candidate; three same-N untimed warmups precede one full public batch sample. This specifies the original positive full-unit pilot calibration without changing the timing sample population.
candidateN: powers of two from1 through original case-specific cap
candidateOrder: A then B; both arms get fresh workers at every candidate N
select: first candidate for which both arms meet target; no case omission, clipping, cap increase or previous-run worker reuse
budgetRule: Use unchanged protocol workerBudget formula with positive measured pilotPerOperationMs=pilot batch elapsed/N and actual pilot whole-process elapsed. Refuse over ceiling; no silent extension.
pilotTimer: synchronous public batch call only, measured before parsing or validation; retain full typed return before assertions
phaseRequirements: sealed source and independent source review
reviewed lifecycle successor for longer workers
bounded global pilot budget selected before launch
new Root phase and coordinated quiet window
